title: Business Development Associate
description:
Business Development Associate

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil (Remote)

Travel: Requires 30-50% Travel

Pay: 128,000-192,000 BRL

About:

Andromeda is a division of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global leader in acquiring and growing vertical market software companies with over 1,200 acquisitions worldwide.

Andromeda, an operating group within Constellation, is expanding its M&A team in Latin America. We are seeking a full-time M&A Business Development Associate based in Sao Paulo to support our efforts in identifying and building relationships with vertical market software companies across the region.

Key Responsibilities:

· Identify, engage, and build trusted relationships with software business owners and founders across Latin America.

· Proactively reach out to potential acquisition targets and maintain consistent follow-ups to nurture strong pipelines.

· Understand business models and financials to qualify opportunities and identify the best fits for Andromeda.

· Present qualified opportunities to the internal M&A team and support due diligence discussions.

· Conduct market research to uncover new verticals, industry trends, and regional opportunities.

· Attend trade shows, in-person meetings, and industry events to expand the network.

Skills and Competencies:

· Strong oral communication and relationship-building skills with C-level executives and business owners.

· Proactive, persistent, and results-oriented mindset with strong work ethic.

· Analytical ability to understand business models and financial performance.

· Intellectual curiosity and initiative to learn new industries.

· Experience using Salesforce and Excel (or similar CRM tools) is highly desirable.

· Spanish native speaker.

· Fluency in English.

Key Performance Indicators:

· Maintain consistent and high-quality outreach to software company owners.

· Build and sustain active relationships with potential acquisition targets.

· Secure NDAs and bring qualified opportunities to internal M&A review.

· Support evaluation and onboarding of new software companies into Andromeda's ecosystem.

Qualifications and Experience:

· Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

· 2–5 years of experience in business development, B2B sales, or financial services, preferably within the software or technology sector.

· Experience or familiarity with M&A, venture capital, or private equity is an asset.

Why Join Us:

· Work with a global leader in software investments with a proven, long-term acquisition strategy.

· Gain hands-on M&A experience and exposure to senior leadership.

· Collaborate with a talented, international team passionate about software and entrepreneurship.

· Opportunity for professional growth within Andromeda.

· Competitive compensation, hybrid flexibility, and a high-performance culture.

Equal Opportunity:

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age.

Buscamos profissionais com energia, foco em resultados e que saibam a importância da primeira abordagem para abrir portas e gerar oportunidades qualificadas.

Em um mercado cada vez mais competitivo e digital, o SDR se tornou uma peça-chave no processo de vendas modernas. Com metodologia, dados e uma abordagem consultiva, seu trabalho será essencial para o sucesso da área comercial.

Responsabilidades:

  • Fazer prospecção ativa por telefone (COLD CALL);
  • Realizar a qualificação dos leads;
  • Manter o sistema de CRM atualizado;
  • Realizar o agendamento de reuniões entre o Representante de Vendas e o potencial cliente;
  • Apoiar o time de vendas no gerenciamento de contas e oportunidades

Qualificações básicas:

  • Gostar de dinheiro;
  • Amar vendas;
  • Totalmente comprometido com as metas e resultados
  • Treinável e flexível às mudanças (durante o projeto, será provável a necessidade de novas técnicas, novos produtos, e novas abordagens)
  • Fortemente auto motivável;
  • Facilidade e gosto em conversas telefônicas - uma parte importante do trabalho será a prospecção via ligação fria (COLD CALL)
  • Facilidade em conversa em público - apresentações para público entre 2 e 8 pessoas.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de prospecção ativa;
  • Facilidades em vencer objeções;
  • Que seja proativo para trabalhar sozinho buscando seus próprios resultados independente de ajuda e necessidade de supervisão;
  • Saber trabalhar com ferramentas do Office: Word, Excel, Outlook e PowerPoint
  • Habilidade em conhecer novos métodos de trabalho. Necessidade de entender e aplicar a forma de trabalho da empresa.

Qualificações preferidas, não obrigatórias:

  • Nível superior (concluído ou em andamento)
  • Boas noções de Marketing – Técnico ou Superior
  • Conhecimento nas ferramentas colaborativas Microsoft.

Experiências prévias desejadas:

  • Experiência como SDR em empresas anteriores;
  • Facilidade de aprendizado de novos métodos de trabalho;
  • Boas habilidades de comunicação.

title: Wholesale Account Director
description:
About GTT:

GTT is a leading networking and security-as-a-service provider for multinational organizations, simply and securely connecting people and machines to data and applications – anywhere in the world. Built on our top-ranked global Tier 1 network, GTT Envision is a single global technology platform to connect, orchestrate, virtualize and automate enterprise networks. Our portfolio includes SASE, SD-WAN, security, internet, voice and other connectivity options, complemented by professional services and exceptional sales and support teams worldwide. We partner with our customers to deliver Greater Technology Together. Learn more at

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute strategies to penetrate Tier 1/2 carriers & ISPs
  • Sell GTT's international network services, including Global WAN, Ethernet, Direct Internet Access, IP Transit, SD-WAN, and MPLS.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with wholesale partners and decision-making units with significant international footprints.
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities from a standing start and revive dormant accounts.
  • Present GTT's value proposition to prospects and customers through compelling proposals and presentations.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from discovery through development to close, ensuring timely execution and deal completion.
  • Collaborate with marketing and internal teams to maximize prospecting initiatives and accelerate pipeline growth.
  • Candidates must speak, English, Spanish and Portuguese.

Required Experience/Qualifications:

The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of the LATAM wholesale carrier market, including the commercial landscape, pricing dynamics, and cross-border connectivity trends. Knowledge of major Tier 1 carriers and regional operators—such as Claro, Telefónica, América Móvil, and Millicom—is essential to identify opportunities and negotiate effectively. This expertise will enable the candidate to position GTT's global network solutions competitively and drive strategic growth in the region.

  • 5–10+ years of experience in wholesale or reseller sales within the telecom or networking industry.
  • Proven track record of negotiating and closing deals with Tier 1 carriers, ISPs, and channel partners.
  • Strong knowledge of global WAN services, Ethernet, DIA, IP Transit, and related technologies.
  • Familiarity with sales methodologies such as SPIN, Miller Heiman, or similar.
  • Ability to engage confidently with technical topics and articulate complex solutions clearly.
  • Experience selling SD-WAN and security solutions.
  • Established network of contacts within the carrier and reseller ecosystem.

Core Competencies:

  • Negotiating
  • Knowledge of successful negotiation concepts and techniques; ability to negotiate successfully across the organization and with external vendors and clients in a constructive and collaborative manner.
  • Networking
  • Understanding of the business value of creating mutually beneficial relationships with individuals outside of incumbent's own organization and ability to generate productive.
  • Sales Proposals and Presentations
  • Knowledge of sales processes, tools, and techniques; ability to prepare and present formal recommendations for how the organization can meet the customer's needs.
  • Value Selling
  • Knowledge of the principles and practices for selling products, technology and services; ability to provide overall product/service 'value' and to differentiate support offerings that address clearly understood customer need.
  • Customer First (Customer Facing)
  • Knowledge of customer interactions, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and partnership. Ability to build an environment supporting customer value creation at every level. Builds relationships with internal and external partners that improve access to resources and expertise.

EEO Statement:

GTT provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, GTT complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Sênior
description:
Somos a Bazar do Precatório

A Bazar do Precatório é uma das empresas da BZR Group, focada na compra e venda de precatórios, que são dívidas reconhecidas pelo governo, a serem pagas a pessoas físicas ou jurídicas após decisão judicial definitiva. Através de tecnologia, inteligência de dados e uma jornada simplificada, conectamos quem tem um precatório a receber com investidores que buscam esse tipo de ativo. O resultado? Liquidez para quem precisa antecipar o recebimento e oportunidades de investimento para quem busca retornos consistentes nesse mercado ainda pouco explorado.

Venha fazer parte do time que transforma o impossível em cotidiano!

Sobre a posição:

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior altamente capacitado(a) e com mentalidade de dono(a) para se juntar ao nosso time de tecnologia. Você será um pilar fundamental na construção e na evolução da nossa arquitetura de backend, garantindo a qualidade, a performance e a escalabilidade dos nossos sistemas. O perfil ideal é de alguém que não apenas domina as tecnologias, mas que também é proativo, gosta de resolver problemas complexos e tem uma forte capacidade de liderança técnica e mentoria.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

Como Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior, você será responsável por:

  • Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento: Projetar, desenvolver e manter sistemas de backend robustos, escaláveis e de alta performance, utilizando Python ou JavaScript/Node.js.
  • Gestão de Dados: Modelar, otimizar e realizar consultas complexas em bancos de dados PostgreSQL, garantindo a integridade e eficiência dos dados.
  • Infraestrutura na Nuvem: Construir, implantar e gerenciar aplicações e serviços em ambiente AWS (Amazon Web Services).
  • Ciclo de Vida do Código: Utilizar Git para controle de versão em um fluxo de trabalho colaborativo, seguindo as melhores práticas.
  • Automação e DevOps: Implementar, manter e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD (Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua) para automatizar testes, builds e deploys.
  • Liderança Técnica: Atuar como referência técnica para a equipe, participando de revisões de código (code reviews), sugerindo melhorias de arquitetura e promovendo boas práticas de desenvolvimento (Clean Code, SOLID, TDD).
  • Mentoria: Guiar e auxiliar no desenvolvimento de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, compartilhando conhecimento e fomentando a cultura de aprendizado contínuo.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em ambientes de produção, assegurando a estabilidade e a confiabilidade dos sistemas.

Requisitos e Habilidades Técnicas (Obrigatórios):

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada como Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior.
  • Domínio avançado em pelo menos uma das seguintes linguagens de backend: Python ou JavaScript/Node.js.
  • Experiência profunda em modelagem e operação de bancos de dados relacionais, especialmente PostgreSQL.
  • Conhecimento prático e experiência com os principais serviços da AWS (como EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM).
  • Domínio de Git e conhecimento de workflows (GitFlow, Trunk-Based, etc.).
  • Vivência na implementação e manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD (utilizando Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, ou similares).
  • Capacidade de projetar sistemas distribuídos, APIs RESTful e compreensão de microsserviços.
  • Inglês técnico para leitura e interpretação de documentações.

Diferenciais (Desejáveis):

  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) usando Terraform ou CloudFormation.
  • Experiência com containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Conhecimento em outras linguagens de backend (Go, Java, C#).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban).

O que oferecemos:

  • Modelo de contratação PJ
  • Modelo híbrido com dias presenciais no nosso escritório na Faria Lima;
  • Wellhub (Gympass) pra cuidar da saúde física e mental;
  • Plano de desenvolvimento com espaço real pra aprender, se desenvolver e crescer junto com a gente;
  • Um ambiente de startup em crescimento, com muita troca, autonomia e espaço pra inovar.

What We Offer

Who We Are

Pressure Washing Marketing Pros is a digital marketing agency focused on Google Ads, SEO, and high-converting web design for exterior cleaning companies. By focusing on this niche, we've discovered and scaled on repeatable processes that allow us to:

Execute based on data and beat "seat of the pants" traditional strategies.

Deliver predictable, high-quality leads with our proven Google Ads system.

Scale results by constantly testing, refining, and optimizing our paid campaigns.

Our speed, output, and constant improvement help set us apart from our competition.

Your Role & Impact

As a Google Ads Specialist on our team, you'll execute and optimize campaigns across 70+ Google Ads accounts and 25+ Local Service Ads accounts. You'll join our existing Google Ads Manager and Google Ads Specialist who have been with the company for years and who are experts with our system. You and the current Specialist will follow our framework, while proactively collaborating with our SEO and client success teams to ensure campaigns are always in-line with overall business goals.

Key Responsibilities

Build campaigns in Google Ads Manager and Ads Editor following our templates and SOPs.

Perform weekly and monthly optimization routines (negative keywords, search term reviews, budgets, ad assets, keyword additions, bidding strategy, etc. ).

Run through QA checklist before launching or editing a campaign (geo settings, match types, naming conventions, conversion actions, etc. ).

Maintain documentation and task updates in ClickUp.

Implement and QA tracking with WhatConverts following established processes.

Run reports in Looker Studio with performance analysis.

Manage Local Service Ads (budget pacing, category, verification checks, etc. ).

Proactively collaborate with SEO and client success managers to align campaign performance with business goals.

Identify areas of improvement to our SOPs based on test results or recurring events.

What You'll Need to Succeed

Minimum of 2 years experience managing Google Ads campaigns for lead generation (non-ecommerce).

Track record of precision execution and zero critical errors in recent work.

Great analytical skillset for search term review, budget pacing, and campaign adjustments.

Familiar with Google Ads Manager, Google Ads Editor, GA4, GTM, Looker Studio, ClickUp, and Slack.

Focus on detail, with ability to follow SOPs 100% and identify opportunities for SOP refinement.

Excellent written English for writing ads, documentation, and communicating with cross-functional teams.

Self-motivated and results-oriented, with strong personal standards for flawless execution.

Bonus Experience (not required):

Experience with Local Service Ads management

Unbounce

Experience optimizing paid campaigns for service-based lead generation

Experience with WhatConverts or CallRail

What We Value

Data-Driven Execution – Campaigns are backed by analytics, SOPs, and real-time data.

Ownership & Accountability – We don't micromanage. We hire A-players who take pride in precision and results.

Proactive Communication – Solutions-oriented communication that is clear and timely across departments and time zones.

Fast-Paced Execution – Weekly optimizations and QA routines are non-negotiable.

Continuous Improvement – We are always refining our systems to push performance higher.

Success Metrics

Zero critical errors found in QA across all campaigns.

100% of weekly optimization routines completed on time.

Campaign pacing within ±5% of budget plan.

Negative keyword coverage improves irrelevant query share quarter-over-quarter.

Reporting completeness rate 95%+ as measured by manager audit.

Compensation, Benefits, and Schedule

Base Salary: $1,200–$2,000 USD/month depending on experience and skill level.

Schedule: Flexible work hours but must be available for mandatory 4-hour team overlap for collaboration with cross-department teams.

Multi-Step Hiring Process

We're serious about hiring because we're serious about building a team of disciplined executors who thrive in a high-performance culture.

The hiring process:

Application and screening questions.

Paid trial project with strict QA rubric.

Final interview and debrief with the manager and CEO.

Acreditamos que a verdadeira transformação só acontece quando diferentes histórias, olhares e trajetórias se encontram. Por isso, valorizamos e promovemos um ambiente diverso, seguro e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam ser quem são — com autonomia, respeito e pertencimento.

Benefícios que fazem a jornada valer a pena

Na Webmotors, acreditamos que cuidar das nossas pessoas é o primeiro passo para acelerar grandes transformações. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar sua saúde, bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida — dentro e fora do trabalho.

Se identificou com esse jeito de cuidar de gente e de crescer com consistência?

Então vem acelerar com a gente.

A Webmotors

A Webmotors existe para simplificar a jornada automotiva completa: da compra à venda, da assinatura ao cuidado com o veículo. São mais de 30 anos de pioneirismo, em constante evolução e inovação. Atualmente, mais de 13 milhões de brasileiros acessam nossa plataforma todos os meses.

Somos Santander desde 2008 e uma empresa do CAR Group, que possui negócios de marketplaces totalmente digitais na Austrália (Carsales), Coreia do Sul (Encar), Estados Unidos (Trader Interactive) e Chile (Chileautos). Além de serem acionistas majoritários da Webmotors no Brasil, a CAR Group emprega mais de 2.500 pessoas em 10 países ao redor do mundo. title: Senior Key Account Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

What You'll Do

  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets;
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta;
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta's influence within the industry;
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform's delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience;
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.

What We Need From You

  • Over 8 years of experience in key account management, channel development, or retail management, with a solid foundation in management methodologies and practices.
  • Strong business negotiation and market expansion skills, with a keen ability to identify client and user needs and a proactive attitude toward challenges.
  • Experienced in process and project management, with the ability to drive multiple tasks and projects concurrently.
  • Highly reliable and resilient, demonstrating strong work enthusiasm and a collaborative team spirit.
  • Fluent in English (speaking, reading, and writing) and capable of using it as a working language; proficiency in Portuguese is a strong plus.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Principal Consultant - SOC Transformation and XSIAM Deployment
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we're looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Your Career
As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.
Your Impact
  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD/MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM/security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel
Additional Information
Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn't stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission. You'll be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and fixing integrations and critical issues as they are raised. But you won't wait for them to be raised, you'll seek them out, too. We fix and identify technical problems with a pointed focus of providing the best customer support in the industry.
Our Commitment
We're problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: HR Business Partner (individual contributor position)
description:
Hi there! Thanks for your curiosity

We're driven by ambition and guided by a bold vision for the years ahead. As we scale our profitable ecosystem of tools and services, we're seeking a dedicated and adaptable HR Business Partner – Brazil (individual contributor position) to help us bring our People strategy to life and support our teams on the ground.

In this position, you will report directly to the Director of People and work closely with leaders and employees to ensure that People processes run efficiently and consistently. This is an individual contributor role with a strong execution component — combining hands-on delivery with collaboration and influence across regional and global teams.

Who we are

Zubale is a technology company that enables retailers to win in eCommerce. We serve a wide range of retailers — from supermarkets, specialty stores, pharmacies, and department stores to fashion brands — across Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru, and Colombia.

We have three key products:

  • Flexifleet – Freelancer Marketplace to perform picking, packing, and delivery tasks for retailers and aggregators.
  • Fulfillment Optimizer – Modular Software to increase productivity in eCommerce picking, packing, and delivery.
  • Consumer Connect – AI WhatsApp Conversational Commerce to boost sales and elevate customer experience.

We are passionate about helping brands, aggregators, and retailers optimize their eCommerce operations, lower costs, and boost profitability.

Backed by over USD 70 million in venture capital, we've delivered consistent growth and completed 100+ million orders through our platform. Today, we serve 100+ customers and engage thousands of freelancers across Latin America — and this is just the beginning.

Who you are

You are a hands-on HR professional who enjoys being close to the business and the people. You combine empathy, structure, and a strong sense of ownership to deliver high-quality results.

You thrive in dynamic environments, balancing operational priorities with thoughtful, people-centered solutions. You're someone who makes things happen while building trust and collaboration across teams.

What you will do

  • Partner with business leaders and employees across Brazil to provide day-to-day support on key HR processes — from onboarding and employee relations to development and engagement.
  • Deliver a best-in-class onboarding experience.
  • Implement surveys, analyze data, and develop action plans to close gaps.
  • Manage Rewards and Incentives: leverage current compensation and incentive plans, as well as benchmarking against other companies and industries to ensure our schemes are fit for the future.
  • Prepare reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends.
  • Protect the organization's value by keeping information confidential.
  • Comply with local legal requirements by studying existing and new legislation; enforcing adherence to requirements; advising management on needed actions.
  • Participate in developing department goals, objectives, and systems.
  • Handle employee relations counseling, outplacement counseling, and exit interviews.
  • Own the plan and logistics of internal events.
  • Implement and sustain People initiatives, ensuring alignment with regional and global priorities.
  • Manage HR operations and documentation with accuracy, confidentiality, and attention to detail.
  • Work closely with regional people partners to align priorities, localize global programs, and ensure effective implementation in Brazil.

The skills and experience you will bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Psychology, or related fields.
  • 4+ years of experience in HR, ideally as a Business Partner in fast-paced or tech environments.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian labor legislation and HR best practices.
  • Experience in employee relations, HR operations, and process implementation.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus).
  • Proactive, collaborative, and detail-oriented, with a genuine interest in helping teams succeed.

title: Analista de Educação Corporativa Sr
description:
Descrição da Empresa:

O Grupo Fleury é uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições de medicina e saúde do Brasil. Referência por sua excelência técnica, médica e de atendimento, é também destaque nas melhores práticas ESG.

Além dos serviços de medicina diagnóstica, o Grupo Fleury conta com uma oferta crescente de serviços que buscam responder às necessidades das pessoas, além de gerar sustentabilidade para o sistema de saúde com a melhor utilização dos recursos investidos. Essas soluções refletem o posicionamento estratégico da empresa de ser um ecossistema de saúde integrada, preventiva e híbrida, combinando ofertas físicas e digitais.

Acreditamos que carreira e propósito caminham juntos, e costumamos falar que somos apaixonados pelas pessoas e pelo que fazemos. Isso reflete em nosso dia a dia, por meio de um trabalho que impacta vidas. Faz parte da nossa essência cuidar das pessoas, colocando as colaboradoras, colaboradores, médicas, médicos e clientes sempre no centro.

Se você tem atitude positiva, empatia, adaptabilidade e deseja se desenvolver em um ambiente repleto de profissionais referências no mercado que prezam por respeito, excelência e inovação, abrace a oportunidade de levar saúde e bem-estar para a plena realização das pessoas!

Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira!

Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa será responsável por prestar atendimento a clientes do Grupo Fleury.

Buscamos alguém que acolha, ouça e entenda as necessidades dos clientes, com foco em preservar o atendimento humanizado, sem deixar de lado a qualidade e excelência que tanto valorizamos.

Sobre a área:

Atuar com influência e resolutividade no diagnóstico de treinamentos técnicos e comportamentais, construindo programas personalizados alinhados as necessidades das avenidas de crescimento e estratégia macro, propósito e ambição do grupo. Liderar, acompanhar e executar os projetos de Educação Corporativa sob a sua responsabilidade com foco na gestão dos indicadores, reportes e necessidades da área e negócio, em linha com as novas tecnologias de educação e desenvolvimento disponíveis no mercado.

Principais atividades:

  • Realizar diagnóstico em sua área de atuação, desenvolver e implementar projetos, programas e soluções personalizadas através da análise dos dados levantados;
  • Apoiar no mapeamento das necessidades de Reskilling e Upskilling e na execução das estratégias de capacitação e educação continuada;
  • Elaborar e acompanhar a realização dos projetos de Educação Corporativa, treinamentos técnicos- comportamentais e validação e gestão de cursos online, híbridos e presenciais conforme sua qualificação e área de competência em treinamentos internos e externos
  • Confeccionar e apresentar relatórios gerenciais, análise de indicadores e plano de ações para os clientes/áreas de atuação;
  • Mapear parceiros e fornecedores de mercado para a realização de cursos, palestras e/ou programas de treinamentos;
  • Elaborar o planejamento anual de desenvolvimento atrelado a estratégia da organização, gestão da performance e metas anuais estipuladas;
  • Planejar e acompanhar logística de treinamento para todos os eventos relacionados à área, zelando pela qualidade, benefício e custos;
  • Administrar e acompanhar os treinamentos internos e externos, por meio de controle e organização dos eventos;
  • Apoiar como referência técnica e comportamental em Educação Corporativa os colaboradores de níveis pleno e júnior.
  • Monitorar as necessidades de atualização das políticas e procedimentos da documentação do sistema de gestão da qualidade da área;
  • Controlar o budget de treinamentos junto a liderança imediata e profissional designado para esta função na área;
  • Conduzir o Onboarding (Integração e formação de novos colaboradores) com foco no aculturamento, treinamento na metodologia de atendimento e modelo de negócios;
  • Promover a avaliação de aptidão em quatro níveis para todos os treinamentos realizados no Grupo Fleury: reação, aprendizado, comportamento e resultado, avaliação de aptidão e delas extraírem os indicadores necessários para a melhoria de nossos serviços;
  • Realizar curadoria e gestão do conhecimento de todos os processos e projetos sob sua responsabilidade.

Buscamos alguém que apresente:

  • Superior Completo em Psicologia, Pedagogia, Administração, Enfermagem, Biomedicina, Farmácia ou similar;
  • Pós-Graduação (Gestão de Pessoas, Negócios, Administração, Educação e afins). Mestrado e Doutorado (Educação, Pessoas, Negócios, Saúde e afins);
  • Idiomas: Inglês (nível básico a intermediário).
  • Desejável conhecimento em EAD, Metodologias ativas, Novas Tecnologias de Educação, Aprendizagem em Rede e Gamificação;
  • Informática e tecnologias: Excel (Intermediário), Power Point, Canvas e Word (avançado).
  • Experiência na área de T&D, Educação Corporativa e afins;
  • Experiência em Gestão de Projetos e Programas educacionais.

Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.

Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:

• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido

Carga Horária: Segunda a Sexta, das 08h00 as 18h00

Unidade IHP Cidade Nova - Minas Gerais.

O que oferecemos:

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Auxílio Creche;

Seguro de Vida;

Gympass;

Participação nos Lucros;

Benefícios exclusivos para promover a saúde e bem-estar das colaboradoras, colaboradores e seus dependentes. Ambulatório com clínica médica, linhas de cuidado: gestante, adoção, oncologia, além da oferta de sessões de terapia, orientação nutricional, orientação para atividades físicas, entre outros.

Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.

Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

title: Analista de FP&A Pleno/Sênior
description:
Local: São Paulo/SP

Área: FP&A

Missão da Área

A área de Planejamento Financeiro e Análise (FP&A) atua como parceira estratégica do negócio, apoiando decisões por meio de análises financeiras sólidas e visão integrada de performance.

Em um setor dinâmico como o de Energia, somos responsáveis por planejar, projetar e acompanhar resultados, assegurando eficiência no uso dos recursos e alinhamento com a estratégia corporativa.

Além de elaborar orçamentos, forecasts e análises de rentabilidade, o time também apoia diversas áreas da companhia, atuando como ponto central e oficial dos dados financeiros, promovendo consistência e integração nas informações.

O FP&A é ainda responsável pela divulgação dos resultados ao mercado, incluindo a preparação do Relatório da Administração, garantindo transparência e credibilidade nas comunicações financeiras.

Mais do que controlar números, a área transforma dados em insights que traduzem a estratégia em resultados concretos, fortalecendo a sustentabilidade e o crescimento de longo prazo da empresa.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão do orçamento de CAPEX (pelo sistema Project Oracle e por planilhas/dashboards) e OPEX (por planilhas/dashboards);
  • Elaboração de controles e indicadores para acompanhamento de metas corporativas;
  • Criação de visões gerenciais por unidade de negócio, com conciliação contábil;
  • Análise detalhada do resultado vs. orçado (DRE e balanço), explorando os drivers de negócio com as áreas de geração e portfólio de energia;
  • Utilização do sistema Oracle PBCS para projeções e simulações financeiras;
  • Criação e automação de planilhas, relatórios e análises, visando eficiência e padronização;
  • Suporte às áreas parceiras no acompanhamento do orçamento e execução;
  • Desenvolvimento de máscaras e templates de reports para uso interno e divulgação externa.

Requisitos Técnicos e Ferramentas

  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência em controladoria/FP&A em ambientes dinâmicos e orientados a dados;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em contabilidade e modelagem financeira;
  • Alta capacidade analítica e visão integrada de negócios;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Proficiência em Excel, PowerPoint e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau);
  • SQL ou Python serão considerados diferenciais.

Soft Skills Desejadas

  • Raciocínio estruturado e pensamento analítico: capacidade de decompor problemas complexos em partes claras e solucionáveis;
  • Aprendizado rápido e curiosidade intelectual: disposição para entender novos temas e negócios com agilidade;
  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade: conforto em ambientes dinâmicos e com mudanças constantes de prioridades;
  • Colaboração e influência: habilidade de trabalhar em equipe e comunicar-se de forma clara com diferentes áreas;
  • Senso de dono e proatividade: autonomia para agir e buscar soluções antes que os problemas apareçam;
  • Gestão da informação e atenção ao detalhe: organização e precisão no tratamento de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Comunicação analítica e storytelling financeiro: clareza para traduzir análises complexas em mensagens objetivas e acionáveis;
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua: foco em otimização de processos, inovação e geração de valor sustentável.

Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência no setor de Energia;
  • Ter trabalhado no controle de CAPEX de grandes projetos;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de planejamento (Hyperion, Oracle PBCS);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de ferramentas de data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks);
  • Experiência comprovada com linguagem SQL ou Python;
  • Inglês fluente.

title: SAP Data Migration Lead Consultant
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.

The ROLE

We are recruiting talented and motivated individuals to join our team delivering data projects for clients across the globe. As a lead data migration consultant at Syniti, you will be responsible for managing a team of migration consultants on all aspects of data work for a process area/workstream. You will work closely with functional consultants and key customer resources, gathering requirements through workshops, building conversion objects, and driving your team's value through all data project phases. You will be responsible for making sure that your team uses your data skills and the Syniti data management platform to assess and iterate through design, build, and deployment, ensuring that the highest customer value is derived from your assigned objects. As a lead member of a Syniti Data Migration team, you will execute against the best practices for successful business transformation and become skilled in the strongest platform to meet all of our customer's needs.

This role has been designated as a remote position, allowing qualified talent throughout the listed country to be considered for the opportunity.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

After an initial training period, a Lead Data Migration Consultant will be expected to:

  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of Syniti's Data Migration methodology.
  • Demonstrate strong proficiency in Syniti's tools, working to prescribed development standards.
  • Good understanding of business processes for one or more assigned functional area, and the ability to quickly learn about new areas.
  • Effectively manage a small team of data migration consultants, to meet assigned responsibilities against the overall project plan.
  • Demonstrate a strong knowledge of underlying technical data structures and definitions of assigned functional process area.
  • Develop data migration rules and reports in the Syniti's tools as per supplied specification.
  • Evaluate and contribute to ongoing data migration design for assigned process area through data analysis, reporting and collaboration with on-site Syniti and client colleagues.
  • Create and maintain data load programs.
  • Maintain related documentation and clearly communicate status to Syniti Team Leadership and customer PMO.
  • Execution of end-to-end data loads and reconciliations.
  • Support and mentor junior colleagues.

WHAT IT TAKES

  • Degree level qualification in Computer Science (or other technology related field).
  • Experience in ETL / Data Migration / Data Quality / Data Analysis.
  • Experience managing resources to deliver a collective goal/responsibility.
  • Functional ERP experience.
  • Project experience across multiple ERP implementations.
  • Database experience - SQL Server, Oracle etc.
  • Customer facing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel according to project requirements up to 100%.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Autonomy and Trust: Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, with minimal micromanagement.
  • Growth Opportunities: We are growing rapidly, offering you the chance to grow with us, shape our journey, and share in our success story.
  • Collaborative Support: We value collaboration and support each other, ensuring you won't stand alone in your endeavors.
  • Diversity of Stories: Genuine interest in your unique story and journey. We celebrate individual achievements and want to hear everyone's story.
  • Recognition: We appreciate and celebrate individual achievements, acknowledging the contribution of each team member.
  • Open Organization: We embrace an open and inclusive culture, where hierarchies are minimized, and access is ensured across the board. Everyone is valued, and ideas are welcomed.

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we're looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Your Career
The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and/or sales opportunities with key customers.
The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.
In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.
Your Impact
  • Escalation Leadership
    • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
    • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
    • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
    • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
    • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
    • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
    • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
    • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
    • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
    • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
    • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
    • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
    • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
    • A "whatever it takes" customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
    • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
    • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process/system/product
    • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
    • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
    • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
    • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • Fully fluent in Portuguese, English, and Spanish both written and verbal
  • Customer Experience
    • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and/or service delivery roles
    • Past experience as Escalations Engineer/Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
    • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program/Project management
    • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
    • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
    • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA/SLO/Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
    • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
    • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
    • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
    • Experience with Networking/Security Products
    • Knowledge of LAN/WAN technologies, encompassing general routing/switching/security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues
Additional Information
The Team
The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.
Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making
As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.
Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.
Our Commitment
We're problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

CRM Engineer – Integration & Automation (Contractor)

REQUISITOS:

  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3).

Envie portfólio com projetos em Webflow (links públicos ou clonables), mostrando:

title: Senior Network Support Engineer
description:
Senior Network Support Engineer / Resident Engineer - Brasilia

The Senior Resident Engineer is responsible for providing onsite technical support services to a specific NETSCOUT | Arbor customer and performing the role of a Subject Matter Expert on NETSCOUT | Arbor security products.

Specific Job Duties and Responsibilities

The Senior Resident Support Engineer relies on experience and judgment to plan and perform a variety of critical tasks / responsibilities pertaining to the customer's NETSCOUT | Arbor deployment. These responsibilities require a high degree of autonomy and accountability and would include:

  • Work with and provide guidance/support to the customer's operational and design staff, in the role of the NETSCOUT Arbor technical Subject Matter Expert.
  • Be a trusted advisor to the customer on all technical areas related to the NETSCOUT Arbor security products.
  • Design, implement, troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve normal and complex technical issues associated with NETSCOUT Arbor security products installed in the customer network.
  • Test and replicate customer configurations in a lab environment as and when required.
  • Ensure the operational and functional requirements pertaining to the NETSCOUT Arbor solution installed in the customer environment are fulfilled from a technical standpoint.
  • Track, investigate, escalate, and verify software defects as encountered and reported by customers
  • Deliver on-demand technical workshops on NETSCOUT security products, to the customer's staff as needed.
  • Work with other NETSCOUT internal functions like technical support, engineering, and product management as needed related to product issues as well as new features.
  • Work closely with the NETSCOUT account team(s) of customer to understand and support the sales strategy from a technical standpoint.
  • Support the tuning and optimization requirements related to the NETSCOUT Arbor installation in the customer environment.
  • Assist and provide expert guidance to the customer security operations teams on security attack mitigations (pre-attack prep, during-attack assistance, post-attack reviews).
  • Develop and implement Method of Procedure documents for procedural and maintenance activities as required, related to the NETSCOUT Arbor products/solutions deployed in the customer environment.
  • Lead and support software upgrade activities or investigations of reported problems related to the NETSCOUT security products installed in the customer environment.
  • Work closely with the NETSCOUT Arbor Professional Services team to discuss, enhance, and share knowledge about product, domain, and solutions.
  • Generate customer-specific product technical documentation, as needed.
  • Continuously develop and update expertise on NETSCOUT products and solutions.
  • Develop and deliver technical presentations to customer and internal teams as needed.
  • Travel as required to customer sites and internationally for corporate events as needed

Experience and Educational Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree, or equivalent, in an associated area with 3+ years of experience in service delivery or technical support functions with strong fundamentals on telecom network and routing environments.
  • Advanced networking skills required (TCP/IP, Routing, BGP, MPLS, and related), NetFlow protocol experience and understanding desirable.
  • Strong network security skills required, knowledge of and experience in DDoS and mitigation techniques beneficial.
  • Knowledge of network test equipment network management protocols like SNMP, tools, and protocols like MRTG, SolarWinds.
  • Knowledge of internet and data security protocols like SSL/TLS, DNS, VPN, IPSEC, GRE.
  • Intermediate to advanced knowledge in administration and provisioning of Unix/Linux and Solaris platforms, networking related scripting and automation skills desirable.
  • Expertise in packet analysis, debugging and troubleshooting, using tools like Wireshark/Tshark
  • Knowledge and experience on virtualization and cloud environment will be a strong skillset to have.
  • Ability to work independently and with where necessary.
  • Strong customer services and verbal/written communication/interpersonal skills.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese, both verbal and written, is required. Knowledge of other languages is an added benefit.
  • Local Country Security Clearance may be required, if applicable in country.
  • Located On-Site in Brasilia

title: Gerente de Marketing
description:
About the Brand We're a bold beauty brand redefining service, fun and results. With our unique DNA and iconic products, we create experiences that go beyond makeup — connecting people, services, and storytelling in every touchpoint.

Role Summary The Marketing Manager 360° sits at the intersection of all cross-functional teams driving the brand and product marketing strategy forward in Brazil. This person blends strategic thinking and creative execution, ensuring the brand remains innovative, disruptive, and locally relevant. You'll bring global campaigns to life in a uniquely Brazilian way, with a consumer-first mindset, a sharp eye for detail, and a passion for brand storytelling and results.

Key Responsibilities

Integrated / 360° Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and execute the full 360° marketing strategy for Brazil, aligned with LATAM and global direction.
  • Bring to life the brand DNA through impactful and locally relevant campaigns, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (creative, digital, retail, PR, influencer, trade, and education) to deliver cohesive brand experiences.
  • Adapt global campaigns and craft localized initiatives based on strategic insights and consumer behavior.
  • Define KPIs and monitor performance to ensure ROI and continuous optimization.
  • Manage marketing budget efficiently and align investments with business priorities.

Brand Activations, Events & Partnerships

  • Ideate and lead brand activations, pop-ups, and in-store experiences that amplify engagement and conversion.
  • Collaborate with influencer and PR teams to develop creative and culturally relevant events, trips, and product send-outs that generate strong EMV and social buzz.
  • Build and manage brand partnerships that expand audience reach while maintaining aspirational image and consistency. This includes experience with negotiating partnership agreements.
  • Oversee the brand's visual merchandising expression across retail doors, ensuring high-quality, on-brand execution.
  • Partner with the Retail & Education teams to boost service awareness and service sales across stores.
  • Coordinate GWP programs, launch activations, and local communication campaigns with a consumer-centric mindset.
  • The ability to analyze ROI for each activation will be key to ensure the spend had a positive impact on retail sales.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Serve as the local bridge between global brand strategy and field execution.
  • Ensure flawless implementation across channels (in-store, online, influencer, social).
  • Lead project timelines, agency briefings, creative reviews, and post-campaign analysis.
  • Partner with Operations, Supply, and Trade Marketing to secure on-time delivery and smooth rollout.
  • Ensure effective communication and collaboration with sales and finance teams to align objectives and maximize results.
  • Report regularly to management on marketing KPIs, results, and insights.

Who You Are

  • 5–10 years of experience in Marketing or Brand Management within beauty, FMCG, or lifestyle industries.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian retail landscape and consumer behavior.
  • Creative and strategic thinker, with a proven ability to innovate within Global brand guidelines and create data-driven digital campaigns that boost brand awareness and sales.
  • Expertise in marketing strategy combined with strong financial acumen, including proven ability to prepare and manage budgets, analyze marketing spend, forecast sales, and develop data-driven strategies aligned with commercial objectives and measurable impact.
  • Excellent project management and multitasking abilities.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across departments.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and deadline-driven.
  • MANDATORY Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus).
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (especially PowerPoint), Google Workspace, and ideally Asana or Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Passion for beauty, trends, and building emotional consumer connections.
  • Experience working with global brands and adapting marketing strategies to local markets.

Success Metrics

  • Growth in brand awareness and preference above market trend.
  • Increase in service sales and store traffic.
  • Strong ROI on campaigns and activations.
  • Excellent cross-functional alignment and execution quality.
  • Elevated brand perception and consumer engagement.

Why Join Us We're not just selling beauty — we're creating moments of joy, confidence, and connection. If you're a marketer who blends creativity, curiosity, and commercial drive, and you want to make an impact in a dynamic, growing brand — this is your next challenge.

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Organizacional Sênior / SP
description:

Responsabilidades da Posição:

  • Desenhar, aprimorar e sustentar a governança dos programas de Aprendiz, Estágio e Trainee, assegurando conformidade legal, coerência com as diretrizes corporativas e aderência à estratégia de desenvolvimento organizacional.
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de atração, desenvolvimento e retenção de talentos, em parceria com as áreas de Atração de Talentos, Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão, e HRBPs.
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de eficácia, retenção e performance dos programas, propondo ajustes estratégicos e apresentando insights de valor para as lideranças e áreas de negócio.

  • Conduzir treinamentos e sessões de alinhamento com as áreas de RH e lideranças, fortalecendo a cultura e a excelência dos programas.

  • Garantir a conformidade integral com a Lei de Aprendizagem (Lei 10.097/2000) e as políticas corporativas.
  • Desenvolver diretrizes, práticas e jornadas formativas que promovam o desenvolvimento profissional e a inclusão social dos jovens aprendizes.
  • Monitorar indicadores corporativos de desempenho e inclusão, assegurando eficiência e impacto social positivo.

Requisitos do Perfil:

  • Formação: Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas; Psicologia, Direito ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência desejável: Experiência prévia em gestão de programas de talentos (Aprendizes, Estagiários, Trainees) em empresas de grande porte, preferencialmente em áreas corporativas ou COEs. Vivência no desenvolvimento de programas de governança e acompanhamento de indicadores de performance e retenção. Experiência com conformidade legal relacionada à gestão de aprendizes (conhecimento da legislação aplicável e cota de aprendiz) e programas de desenvolvimento de jovens profissionais.

Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Gestão de programas de Estágio, Trainee e Aprendiz, incluindo governança e legislação.
  • Desenho e acompanhamento de jornadas de desenvolvimento e indicadores de eficácia/retenção.
  • Excel e PowerPoint (nível intermediário a avançado).
  • Gestão de stakeholders e relacionamento com HRBPs e áreas de negócio.
  • Noções de diversidade e inclusão aplicadas a programas de entrada.

Competências Interpessoais:

  • Autonomia, Proatividade e agilidade com resultados.
  • Clareza e objetividade na comunicação.
  • Capacidade analítica, boa organização e priorização de demandas.
  • Relacionamento e colaboração com diferentes públicos.

title: Grid Connection Engineer
description:
Job Responsibilities:

1. Participate in regular project meetings, summarize and follow up the problems with the site-specific model, and deal with customer emails/requests;

2. Visit customers, communicate with customers on model technical issues, and participate in technical exchange meetings of power grid companies/customers;

3. Collaborate with internal teams to propose solutions to control system and modelling problems;

4. Testing of simulation models and related manuals for new energy grid-connected related equipment;

5. Work with the model development and HIL testing teams to validate new products against regional grid code requirements.

6. Understand new grid code and product requirements emerging in the relevant region;

7. Collect the technical data of competing products, sort out and analyze the models, simulation reports, etc.

Qualifications:

1. Bachelor's degree or above in electrical engineering or a related field.

2. Strong English technical communication skills and English document writing skills. Spanish also request to cover LATAM region;

3. Proficient in DIgSILENT PowerFactory and PSCAD for power system simulation and modeling.

4. Experience with at least one programming language such as Python, etc.

5. Experience in control system design of wind, solar, or storage converters and grid-connected modeling and delivery, both domestically and internationally, is preferred.

6. Experience with EMTP-RV and ANATEM is a differential.

Job location:

Vila Olimpia, São Paulo/Brazil

O grupo engloba marcas icônicas como Fiat, Jeep, Peugeot, Citroën e Chrysler, e atua no desenvolvimento, produção e comercialização de veículos e soluções de mobilidade.

Com uma presença forte em todo o mundo, com operações em mais de 130 países, a Stellantis não apenas fabrica carros, mas também investe em tecnologias para o futuro da mobilidade, como eletrificação, conectividade, software e mobilidade sustentável.

  • Realizar diagnóstico focado na verificação das vozes dos clientes e na ROOT CAUSE nas pesquisas NPS
  • Participar de novos projetos com foco na diferenciação dos Brands frente aos concorrentes (Encantamento)
  • Promotor de Cultura da Qualidade (Compromissos e valores de qualidade da marca disseminado em todas as Diretorias, Regionais, Rede e Associações)

Ponto importante: Essa é uma posição CDD, com um contrato por tempo determinado de 2 anos, com possibilidade de extensão.

title: Area Zone Manager
description:
Neptune Group of Companies is a leader in maritime logistics and transportation, offering sustainable, efficient, and innovative solutions across vehicle logistics, dry bulk shipping, and automotive-focused land services. Honoring its family maritime heritage, the Group combines cutting-edge technologies with its signature "Wake Forward" philosophy, driving adaptability and excellence in modern logistics.

The Group includes Neptune Lines, Neptune Shipping Agencies, Neptune Dry Management, Neptune Land Services, and FERST Logistics, each offering specialized expertise. From maritime transport to land-based operations, Neptune Group delivers seamless, end-to-end solutions tailored to its partners' evolving needs. In this context, the Group is also developing "NLS Port-La-Nouvelle," its first dedicated automotive port terminal, located in southern France.

Guided by core values of integrity, operational excellence, and continuous improvement, Neptune Group remains committed to driving sustainable growth and strengthening its leadership across the logistics industry.

We are seeking a motivated and commercially driven Area Zone Manager (Latin America) to join our Commercial team. In this role, you will manage the implementation of sales initiatives in order to promote and sell Neptune Group services, generate revenues, and build client relationships with assigned customer accounts or prospective clients, serving as the main sales contact point. You will also be responsible for growing the Group's services in the assigned territory (mainly Brazil and Argentina), in accordance with corporate objectives, by providing relevant market intelligence, finding and developing qualified leads, and converting them into prospects and clients.

The preferable candidate will be based in Santos (Brazil).

Reporting directly to the Commercial Director, Key Accountabilities include:

  • Drive sales growth in Brazil, Argentina, and wider Latin America by developing and executing territory sales plans.
  • Build strong pipelines and long-term relationships with clients, prospects, and key stakeholders through regular engagement and business reviews.
  • Coordinate the set-up and future management of an agencies' network, while monitoring competitors, market trends, and risks.
  • Support tenders, prepare quotations, negotiate agreements, and contribute to closing sales.
  • Represent Neptune Lines at client meetings, industry events, and exhibitions to promote services and strengthen brand presence in the region.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Business, Marketing, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • 8–10 years of proven experience in sales, business development, and account management within the logistics/transportation sector (ocean and air freight, import/export), with a strong track record in Latin American markets.
  • Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish (oral and written).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and experience with CRM systems.
  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Brazil, Argentina, wider Latin America, and occasionally to Neptune Lines' headquarters in Europe.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify opportunities and deliver growth.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Consultative sales approach with proven negotiation skills.
  • Ability to build strong client and stakeholder relationships at all levels.
  • Self-motivated, resilient, and results driven.
